definitions.short: an asp or other venomous serpent
definitions.full: H660. epheh אֶפְעֶה noun [masculine] a kind of viper (Thes 'a flando et sibilando;' compare Arabic viper , Ethiopic id. ); — ׳א Isa 30:6 ; 59:5 , א ׳לְשׁוֺן Job 20:16 .
